title: Curry Scores 29 as Warriors Beat Heat 120-100 for Sixth Straight Win
dek: Golden State pulled away in the third quarter at Chase Center, and Stephen Curry hit six threes. The win is the Warriors' sixth in a row after a 0-3 start.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: The exterior of Chase Center, the Warriors' arena in San Francisco (file photo)

keyPoints: The Warriors beat the Heat 120-100 at Chase Center on Thursday, their sixth straight win after an 0-3 start.
Stephen Curry scored 29 points, 22 after halftime, with six three-pointers.
Yaxel Lendeborg had 17 points, eight rebounds and six assists; Draymond Green had a season-high 11 assists.
In Phoenix, Devin Booker scored 30 as the Suns beat the Magic 117-104.
body:
The Golden State Warriors beat the Miami Heat 120-100 on Thursday night at Chase Center, extending their winning streak to six games after an 0-3 start to the 2026-27 season, according to The Sports Encounter and ESPN's scoreboard.

## Curry takes over after halftime

Stephen Curry scored 29 points, 22 of them after halftime, and hit six three-pointers, The Sports Encounter reported. The teams were tied at the break before Golden State outscored Miami in the third quarter, which the Warriors led 38-23 by ESPN's line score.

Draymond Green added a season-high 11 assists. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 17 points, eight rebounds and six assists. ESPN listed Giannis Antetokounmpo with 20 points and 14 rebounds for Miami, and The Sports Encounter said Bam Adebayo also recorded a double-double.

## Warriors improve to 6-3

ESPN's scoreboard lists Golden State at 6-3 overall and 4-1 at home, and Miami at 3-6 overall and 2-3 on the road. The win extended a run that followed an 0-3 start to the season.

## Suns also win

In Phoenix, the Suns beat the Orlando Magic 117-104. Devin Booker scored 30 points and Dillon Brooks added 24, ESPN reported, ending Phoenix's four-game losing streak. Wendell Carter Jr. scored 27 points and grabbed 13 rebounds for Orlando, which lost its sixth game of the season.

Both Thursday games were won by the home team. The Sports Encounter noted that both winners built control in the third quarter after close first halves.

## Quarter by quarter

ESPN's line score shows the Warriors trailing the Heat 26-29 after the first quarter, then outscoring Miami 27-24 in the second and 38-23 in the third. Golden State finished with 29 in the fourth against Miami's 24, for a final score of 120-100. The Heat had led by three after one quarter, and the Warriors were tied 53-53 at the half.

Phoenix followed a similar pattern. ESPN's line score has Orlando ahead 26-33 after one quarter, but the Suns led 63-51 at halftime and 96-73 after three quarters, then won 117-104. Booker's 30 points and eight assists led Phoenix, and Brooks added 24.

## Context for the season

Both games were the first Thursday results of the week, and ESPN listed both as wins for the home team. The Warriors, who opened 0-3, have now won six straight and are 6-3 overall, according to ESPN. Miami is 3-6 overall, and Orlando is 2-6, ESPN reported.

## What comes next

ESPN's scoreboard lists Miami at 2-3 on the road this season. Check the league's official schedule for the next game dates.
